name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: A small chat window with a contact header and message bubbles in several tones and alignments. Clicking the long reply adds a party-popper reaction badge with a count.
use: A page needs to preview or mock a conversation with clear sender sides and message tones.
avoid: It is a presentational shell: sending, typing and live updates must be wired up yourself.
a11y: The clickable bubble has a focus ring, but the reaction badge and emoji carry no accessible label or live announcement. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card starts with a tiny avatar and contact header, then a stack of message bubbles: grey on the left, white on the right, a pale green tint and a red error bubble. Bubbles are rounded rectangles of varied widths.
behaves: The long right-hand message is a button; clicking it toggles a small party-popper badge with a count that overlaps its lower edge. Bubble colour and side follow the chosen variant and alignment.
customise: Message text is passed as children; variant, alignment and reaction side/alignment are props, while colours come from theme tokens.
weight: light: Plain DOM bubbles with a conditional badge; nothing animates on its own.
